# netbox_module_type_profile (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/moduletypeprofile/):

> A module type profile defines the attributes that modules of a module type can have, with a JSON schema.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_module_type_profile" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number)
- `schema` (String)
- `tags` (Set of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String)
